A part of your game

A menu that belongs
inside TUNG.

Press F10 or click Mods to open Wood’s native Unreal interface. Change settings, choose a preset, and return to your run.

The launcher stays available for setup and mod management. Your in-game controls use TUNG’s own widget system.

From download to practice

Ready in three steps.

01 / DOWNLOAD

Get the installer.

A single Windows executable includes Wood and the pinned UE4SS runtime.

02 / INSTALL

Choose your TUNG folder.

Setup detects Steam libraries and can configure the game’s launch options for you.

03 / PLAY

Launch. Press F10.

Open the native mod menu, pick your speed, and start practicing.

Make the next attempt count.

Start with Time Warp. Add your own tools as you go.
